Class DataManager

java.lang.Object
com.ads.DataManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.ads.interfaces.IDataManager
public class DataManager extends Object implements com.ads.interfaces.IDataManager
DataManager is responsible for managing data operations such as reads, writes, commits, aborts, and handling site failures and recoveries.

      public VersionedValue read(String transactionId, String variableId, int startTime) throws com.ads.exceptions.StaleReadException, com.ads.exceptions.SiteDownException, com.ads.exceptions.DataManagerException
      Description copied from interface: com.ads.interfaces.IDataManager
